title: Rena Malik, MD Podcast
author: Rena Malik, MD
description: Finally, honest answers to the questions you're too embarrassed to ask. Hosted by board-certified urologist and pelvic surgeon Dr. Rena Malik, this podcast delivers science-backed solutions for sexual health, relationships, and total health optimization. From 'why is my sex drive tanking?' to 'how do I get better in bed'—Dr. Malik teams up with top experts to tackle the intimate health questions you've been Googling at 2am. Walk away with practical, evidence-based advice you can use today to transform your sex life, boost your confidence, and strengthen your relationships. Subscribe now and join thousands taking charge of their health and happiness.
